name: Barbian (Italy)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of white, red and white, charged with the municipal arms of Barbiano (three towers on green above a black and white chequy).
history: Municipal flag of Barbian, a comune in Trentino-South Tyrol; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Barbiano arms — three towers on green above a black and white chequy
